PHASE 15 — CLIENT-SPECIFIC AI INSTANCES
“Per-Client Brain” Architecture for Neon Vision
15.1 Purpose of Phase 15

This phase enables isolated, intelligent AI brains per client — without spinning up new apps, models, or infrastructure.

Each client gets:

Their own memory

Their own tone

Their own KPIs

Their own historical context

Zero cross-client leakage

Result:

You scale clients without scaling cognitive load.

15.2 What a “Client Brain” Is (Clear Definition)

A Client Brain is:

A scoped retrieval layer

Bound to one client_id

Governed by strict permissions

Running on the same Neon Vision core

It is NOT:

A new chatbot

A new model

A new UI

A fork of Neon Vision

15.3 Client Brain Stack (Logical Layers)
Neon Vision Core (Fixed)
│
├── Global Brand Brain (DTM)
│
├── Internal Ops Brain (DTM-only)
│
└── Client Brain (Isolated per client_id)
     ├── Client Knowledge
     ├── Client Tone
     ├── Client KPIs
     ├── Client History
     └── Client Constraints
